title: Beam diagram creator
summary: The data of the Beam diagram notebook on the site: a straight beam on pinned and fixed supports under point forces, couples and distributed loads, solved by the stiffness method for reactions, shear force, bending moment and deflection, with hand calculations by Macaulay's method and an MSC Nastran SOL 101 deck. This folder keeps the page data (raw.json), the test beams with their closed forms (fixtures.json) and the frozen answers of an independent exact-arithmetic Python solver (reference.json), which the notebook checks itself against at every build.
